messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate-hosted. 5m error rate 17.8% (baseline <0.5%). Spike start ~1905130100. Possible batcher/scheduler HOL saturation. Paging oncall: sam. PagerID P-9876

sam: ack. joining now. any immediate customer impact?

maria: seeing many 504 at the gateway. Traces show long queuing inside the scheduler/batcher layer, lots of requests queued >8s. A subset of worker hosts have inflated model step times and KV cache churn.

dmitri: batcher metrics show several long-running batches containing one enormous request (context >30k tokens) that delays batch flushes. Scheduler backlog ~1.1k, avg wait ~6s, p99 wait ~20s.

sam: initial mitigation options: (1) lower max-batch-token threshold, (2) enable per-request fairness / preemption, (3) route portion of traffic to a smaller model variant. Which is fastest to flip?

maria: quickest is lowering batching threshold to 8k and enabling size-based fairness. I can push a scheduler config patch in ~2m. That will reduce HOL risk but increase per-token cost.

dmitri: router split to a smaller variant (gptx-small) is doable; I'll prepare a temporary 30% split. That relieves pressure while we fix batcher.

sam: go ahead maria for scheduler change. Include a short TTL so we can rollback. Command I'll run locally: 

```
# update scheduler config
curl -s -X POST https://internal-config/api/v1/scheduler -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SCHED_API' \
  -d '{"max_batch_token_threshold":8000,"enable_size_fairness":true,"ttl_seconds":900}'
```

sam: pushed config. ops-bot shows acceptance. Watching queue drain.

ops-bot: Scheduler config updated by sam at 1905130205. Backlog: 1123 -> 460.

tracy: quick traffic note: surge traced to two high-throughput tenants exporting long chat contexts. CS alerted for those accounts.

maria: after threshold change backlog dropped: ~460 -> ~160 in 3m. p95 latency reduced from ~3.4s to ~1.2s. 5xx rate dropped to ~5% but not baseline.

dmitri: applying router split 30% -> gptx-small for best-effort traffic now. Rule applied.

```
# router temp split
POST /internal-router/rules
match: /v1/generate-hosted
split: primary 70% | gptx-small 30%
reason: incident mitigation
```

ops-bot: Router split applied by dmitri at 1905130278.

sam: still seeing lingering long-wait requests. I'm going to enable an eviction policy for requests queued >10s to avoid full saturation. This will return 503s for those requests but prevent worse degradation.

maria: enabling eviction now. Note this will surface some 503s to callers; preferring predictable availability over complete queue pileup.

sam: eviction toggled. backlog ~160 -> ~40 quickly. 5xx rate now ~1.1%, gateway 504s down to baseline.

tracy: CS notified top affected tenants with sample traces. Preparing customer-facing blurb. Peak affected requests estimate ~14k/min; roughly 10-12% errored during worst window. Dedicated customers on reserved capacity were unaffected.

ian: inbound takeover in 30m. please include me on handoff.

sam: noted. handoff to ian in progress. Outline of steps taken in incident doc and commands executed are being recorded.

maria: preliminary root cause: a few large-context requests from customers co-batched with small requests. These huge contexts caused per-step slowdown + KV cache churn on certain model variants, which elongated batch durations and produced HOL blocking.

dmitri: agreed. long-term mitigations: enforce per-tenant token caps, prevent co-batching of huge requests with small ones (size isolation), add preemption/circuit-breakers for long-running requests, and automated router fallback when queue depth exceeds SLO thresholds.

maria: I'll open follow-up tickets for eng-runtime and router teams. Also propose a runbook entry for HOL caused by oversized request co-batching.

tracy: CS will draft customer comms and offer extended logs and remediation suggestions for the tenants that hit large contexts.

sam: turning paging off for me. please keep ian looped. Post-incident ticket INC-2026-914 created.

ops-bot: Incident marked handed off at 1905130345. Assigned post-incident ticket INC-2026-914.

maria: action items:
- ENG-RT-234: enforce batch isolation & per-tenant token caps (P1)
- ENG-ROUTER-89: automated fallback rule when queue depth > threshold
- SRE-401: add runbook entry and dashboard for HOL due to large requests

dmitri: ENG-RT will prototype preemption and size-aware batching algorithm in the next sprint, will provide an experimental rollout to canary hosts.

ian: taking oncall. I'll monitor the routing split, eviction events, and queue depth dashboards. Sam, thanks for the quick moves.

sam: thanks team. please upload traces, selected request ids, and config diffs into the incident doc for the RCA. We'll schedule a follow-up tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
